title: PM-KISAN
text:
GOVERNMENT SCHEME: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
Category: Income Support
Key Objective: Income support of ₹6000 per year to all landholding farmer families
Farmer Eligibility: All landholding farmer families
Direct Financial Benefits: ₹2000 every 4 months in 3 installments
Official Application Portal: https://pmkisan.gov.in/

title: PMFBY
text:
GOVERNMENT SCHEME: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
Category: Insurance
Key Objective: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support against crop loss
Farmer Eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops
Direct Financial Benefits: Insurance coverage for crop loss due to natural calamities
Official Application Portal: https://pmfby.gov.in/

title: Soil Health Card
text:
GOVERNMENT SCHEME: Soil Health Card (Soil Health Card Scheme)
Category: Soil Management
Key Objective: Provides soil health cards with nutrient status and recommendations
Farmer Eligibility: All farmers
Direct Financial Benefits: Free soil testing and customized fertilizer recommendations
Official Application Portal: https://soilhealth.dac.gov.in/

title: KCC
text:
GOVERNMENT SCHEME: KCC (Kisan Credit Card)
Category: Credit
Key Objective: Credit facility for farmers for agricultural and allied activities
Farmer Eligibility: Farmers with land ownership or tenant farmers
Direct Financial Benefits: Easy credit at subsidized interest rates (4% net) up to ₹3 lakh
Official Application Portal: https://www.india.gov.in/spotlight/kisan-credit-card-kcc

title: PM-KUSUM
text:
GOVERNMENT SCHEME: PM-KUSUM (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan)
Category: Solar & Energy
Key Objective: De-dieselization and solarization of agricultural pump sets
Farmer Eligibility: Farmers with agricultural land
Direct Financial Benefits: Up to 60% subsidy for standalone solar pumps, income from solar power
Official Application Portal: https://pmkusum.mnre.gov.in/

title: PMKSY
text:
GOVERNMENT SCHEME: PMKSY (Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana)
Category: Irrigation
Key Objective: Irrigation scheme to improve water use efficiency - Per Drop More Crop
Farmer Eligibility: All farmers
Direct Financial Benefits: Subsidy on drip/sprinkler irrigation (up to 55%), farm ponds
Official Application Portal: https://pmksy.gov.in/

title: SMAM
text:
GOVERNMENT SCHEME: SMAM (Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization)
Category: Machinery & Equipment
Key Objective: Promotes farm mechanization and Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs)
Farmer Eligibility: Small and marginal farmers / FPOs
Direct Financial Benefits: 40% to 50% subsidy on tractors, harvesters, and implements
Official Application Portal: https://agrimachinery.nic.in/

title: PKVY
text:
GOVERNMENT SCHEME: PKVY (Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana)
Category: Organic Farming
Key Objective: Promotes organic farming clusters and reduces chemical fertilizer use
Farmer Eligibility: Farmers willing to adopt organic farming in clusters
Direct Financial Benefits: ₹50,000 per hectare for 3 years (₹31,000 directly for inputs)
Official Application Portal: https://pgsindia-ncof.gov.in/

title: AIF
text:
GOVERNMENT SCHEME: AIF (Agriculture Infrastructure Fund)
Category: Infrastructure & Credit
Key Objective: Financing facility for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets
Farmer Eligibility: FPOs / PACS / Agri-entrepreneurs / Farmers
Direct Financial Benefits: Interest subvention of 3% p.a. for loans up to ₹2 crore for 7 years
Official Application Portal: https://agriinfra.dac.gov.in/

title: e-NAM
text:
GOVERNMENT SCHEME: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
Category: Marketing
Key Objective: Pan-India electronic trading portal connecting APMC mandis
Farmer Eligibility: All farmers and registered traders
Direct Financial Benefits: Better price discovery, transparent online auction, single license across state
Official Application Portal: https://enam.gov.in/

title: PM-KMY
text:
GOVERNMENT SCHEME: PM-KMY (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana)
Category: Social Security
Key Objective: Old-age pension scheme for small and marginal farmers
Farmer Eligibility: Small and marginal farmers aged 18 to 40
Direct Financial Benefits: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 upon reaching 60 years of age
Official Application Portal: https://maandhan.in/

title: MIDH
text:
GOVERNMENT SCHEME: MIDH (Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture)
Category: Horticulture
Key Objective: Holistic growth of horticulture sector covering fruits vegetables and spices
Farmer Eligibility: Horticulture growers and FPOs
Direct Financial Benefits: Subsidy on polyhouses, pack houses, cold storages, high-yield planting material
Official Application Portal: https://midh.gov.in/

title: NFSM
text:
GOVERNMENT SCHEME: NFSM (National Food Security Mission)
Category: Production
Key Objective: Increase production of rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals and nutri-cereals
Farmer Eligibility: Farmers in identified districts
Direct Financial Benefits: Subsidized certified seeds, micro-nutrients, farm implements
Official Application Portal: https://nfsm.gov.in/

title: PMMSY
text:
GOVERNMENT SCHEME: PMMSY (Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana)
Category: Allied Agriculture
Key Objective: Integrated development of fisheries and aquaculture infrastructure
Farmer Eligibility: Fishermen / Fish farmers / SHGs
Direct Financial Benefits: 40% to 60% subsidy for pond construction, biofloc, RAS, and transport
Official Application Portal: https://pmmsy.dof.gov.in/

title: WHEAT Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: WHEAT
Crop: WHEAT
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: 6 critical irrigations: CRI (21 days), Tillering (40-45d), Late Jointing (60-65d), Flowering (80-85d), Milking (100-105d), Dough (115-120d).
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 60kg N, 60kg P2O5, 40kg K2O per ha. Top dress: 30kg N at 1st irrigation, 30kg N at 2nd irrigation.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 110-135 days days
Optimal Temperature: 12°C to 25°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 50% to 70%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: RICE Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: RICE
Crop: RICE
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Keep field flooded with 2-3 inches water till panicle initiation. Alternate wetting & drying (AWD) saves 30% water. Drain 12-15 days before harvest.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 60kg N, 40kg P2O5, 40kg K2O, 25kg ZnSO4/ha. Top dress: 30kg N at tillering, 30kg N at panicle initiation.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 120-155 days days
Optimal Temperature: 20°C to 35°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 70% to 90%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: MAIZE Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: MAIZE
Crop: MAIZE
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Knee-high (30d), Tasseling (50d), and Silking (65-70d) are critical. Irrigate every 10-12 days in hot periods. Avoid waterlogging.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 40kg N, 60kg P2O5, 40kg K2O/ha. Top dress: 40kg N at knee-high, 40kg N at silking.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 90-115 days days
Optimal Temperature: 18°C to 32°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 55% to 75%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: BAJRA Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: BAJRA
Crop: BAJRA
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Highly drought tolerant. Usually rainfed. 1-2 irrigations at tillering and flowering boost grain yield by 40%.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 40kg N, 30kg P2O5, 20kg K2O/ha. Top dress: 40kg N at 30 days after sowing.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 75-90 days days
Optimal Temperature: 24°C to 38°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 35% to 65%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: JOWAR Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: JOWAR
Crop: JOWAR
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Irrigate at seedling (15-20d), primordial initiation (35-40d), and flag leaf/flowering (60-65d). Avoid standing water.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 40kg N, 40kg P2O5, 40kg K2O/ha. Top dress: 40kg N at 30-35 days after emergence.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 95-120 days days
Optimal Temperature: 22°C to 36°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 40% to 68%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: RAGI Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: RAGI
Crop: RAGI
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Light irrigation after transplanting. 4-5 irrigations at tillering, flowering, and grain filling stages.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 30kg N, 30kg P2O5, 20kg K2O/ha + 5 tonnes FYM. Top dress: 30kg N at 3 weeks after transplanting.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 105-125 days days
Optimal Temperature: 18°C to 32°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 50% to 80%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: BARLEY Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: BARLEY
Crop: BARLEY
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Requires 2-3 irrigations: Active tillering (30-35d) and Flag leaf to flowering (60-65d).
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 30kg N, 30kg P2O5, 20kg K2O/ha. Top dress: 30kg N after first irrigation.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 105-130 days days
Optimal Temperature: 12°C to 24°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 45% to 65%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: SUGARCANE Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: SUGARCANE
Crop: SUGARCANE
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Heavy water requirement (1500-2000mm). Irrigate every 8-10 days in formative stage (60-130d) and grand growth stage (130-250d). Stop 20 days prior to harvest.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 75kg N, 60kg P2O5, 60kg K2O/ha. Top dress: 75kg N at 45 days, 100kg N at 90 days with earthing up.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 300-360 days days
Optimal Temperature: 20°C to 38°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 65% to 88%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: COTTON Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: COTTON
Crop: COTTON
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Light irrigation at sowing. Critical stages: square formation (45d), flowering (70d), and boll development (90-110d). Never let soil dry during boll burst.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 40kg N, 30kg P2O5, 30kg K2O/ha. Top dress: 40kg N at square formation, 40kg N at peak flowering.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 150-180 days days
Optimal Temperature: 21°C to 36°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 55% to 80%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: JUTE Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: JUTE
Crop: JUTE
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Pre-sowing irrigation for seed germination. Rainfed during monsoon; irrigate at 15-day intervals if dry spell occurs.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 30kg N, 30kg P2O5, 30kg K2O/ha. Top dress: 30kg N foliar spray at 35-40 days.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 120-140 days days
Optimal Temperature: 24°C to 37°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 70% to 90%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: TEA Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: TEA
Crop: TEA
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: High rainfall (1500-2500mm). Drip irrigation during dry winter/spring (Nov-Apr) maintains green leaf production.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: N:P2O5:K2O in 2:1:2 ratio. 120-140kg N/ha split into 4 equal doses during active flushing periods.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: Perennial (Pluck every 7-10 days) days
Optimal Temperature: 15°C to 30°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 75% to 95%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: RUBBER Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: RUBBER
Crop: RUBBER
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Perennial crop needing well-distributed rainfall (2000-3000mm). Young saplings require weekly watering in dry months.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 30:30:30 NPK mixture. Mature trees: 30kg N, 30kg P, 30kg K/ha applied pre-monsoon and post-monsoon.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: Perennial (Tapping starts at 7 years) days
Optimal Temperature: 22°C to 34°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 75% to 92%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: COFFEE Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: COFFEE
Crop: COFFEE
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Blossom shower (25-40mm) in Feb-Mar triggers uniform flowering. Backing shower (15-25mm) after 2-3 weeks aids fruit set.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Split applications: Pre-blossom (40kg N, 30kg P, 40kg K/ha), Post-monsoon (40kg N, 30kg P, 40kg K/ha).
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: Perennial (Harvest Nov-Feb) days
Optimal Temperature: 16°C to 28°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 70% to 90%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: MUSTARD Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: MUSTARD
Crop: MUSTARD
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Requires 2 irrigations: 1st at flowering/rosette stage (28-35d), 2nd at siliqua/pod formation (60-65d). Avoid water stagnation.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 40kg N, 30kg P2O5, 20kg K2O, 20kg Sulfur/ha. Top dress: 40kg N at 1st irrigation.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 105-135 days days
Optimal Temperature: 10°C to 25°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 45% to 65%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: SOYBEAN Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: SOYBEAN
Crop: SOYBEAN
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Mostly Kharif rainfed. Critical dry spell stages: Flowering (35-45d) and Pod filling (60-70d). Give 1 protective irrigation if rain fails.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 25kg N, 60kg P2O5, 40kg K2O, 20kg Sulfur/ha. Inoculate seeds with Rhizobium japonicum culture.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 90-110 days days
Optimal Temperature: 20°C to 32°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 60% to 80%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: GROUNDNUT Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: GROUNDNUT
Crop: GROUNDNUT
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Irrigate at flowering (25-30d), peg penetration (40-50d), and pod development (65-75d). Pegging stage water stress causes empty pods.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 25kg N, 50kg P2O5, 40kg K2O, 200kg Gypsum at flowering/pegging for calcium uptake.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 105-125 days days
Optimal Temperature: 22°C to 34°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 55% to 75%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: SUNFLOWER Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: SUNFLOWER
Crop: SUNFLOWER
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Irrigate at bud initiation (30-35d), flowering (50-55d), and seed filling (70-75d).
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 30kg N, 60kg P2O5, 30kg K2O, 20kg Sulfur/ha. Top dress: 30kg N at 30 days after sowing.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 85-100 days days
Optimal Temperature: 18°C to 30°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 50% to 70%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: CHICKPEA Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: CHICKPEA
Crop: CHICKPEA
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Requires 1-2 light irrigations: Pre-flowering (45d) and Pod development (75d). Never irrigate during peak flowering.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 20kg N, 40kg P2O5, 20kg K2O/ha. Seed treatment with Rhizobium and PSB biofertilizer.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 100-125 days days
Optimal Temperature: 15°C to 28°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 45% to 70%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: PIGEONPEAS Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: PIGEONPEAS
Crop: PIGEONPEAS
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Branching (30-35d), Flowering (60-70d), and Pod development (90-100d). Good drainage is crucial; sensitive to waterlogging.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 25kg N, 50kg P2O5, 20kg K2O, 20kg Sulfur/ha. Seed treatment with Rhizobium.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 140-180 days days
Optimal Temperature: 20°C to 35°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 50% to 75%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: MUNGBEAN Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: MUNGBEAN
Crop: MUNGBEAN
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Short duration. 2-3 irrigations: Sowing, flowering (25-30d), and pod development (40d).
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 20kg N, 40kg P2O5, 20kg K2O/ha.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 60-75 days days
Optimal Temperature: 22°C to 35°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 50% to 75%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: BLACKGRAM Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: BLACKGRAM
Crop: BLACKGRAM
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Irrigate at 20-25 days (flowering) and 40 days (pod filling).
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 20kg N, 40kg P2O5, 20kg K2O/ha.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 70-85 days days
Optimal Temperature: 22°C to 35°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 55% to 80%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: LENTIL Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: LENTIL
Crop: LENTIL
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: 1 light irrigation at pod formation (45-50d) if winter rains are absent.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 20kg N, 40kg P2O5, 20kg K2O/ha.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 110-130 days days
Optimal Temperature: 14°C to 25°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 45% to 65%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: KIDNEYBEANS Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: KIDNEYBEANS
Crop: KIDNEYBEANS
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Irrigate at 10-15 day intervals. Keep soil moist throughout flowering and pod fill.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 40kg N, 60kg P2O5, 40kg K2O/ha. Needs higher N as it fixes less nitrogen than other pulses.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 90-120 days days
Optimal Temperature: 15°C to 27°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 55% to 75%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: MOTHBEANS Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: MOTHBEANS
Crop: MOTHBEANS
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Extremely drought resistant. Grown as rainfed crop in arid Rajasthan and Gujarat.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 15kg N, 30kg P2O5/ha.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 75-90 days days
Optimal Temperature: 25°C to 38°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 35% to 60%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: POTATO Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: POTATO
Crop: POTATO
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Light frequent irrigations every 7-10 days. Stolon formation (20-25d) and Tuber bulking (45-60d) are critical. Stop 10 days before harvest for skin hardening.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 75kg N, 100kg P2O5, 100kg K2O/ha. Top dress: 75kg N at earthing up (30 days). Potatoes are potassium-hungry.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 85-110 days days
Optimal Temperature: 14°C to 24°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 65% to 85%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: TOMATO Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: TOMATO
Crop: TOMATO
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Drip irrigation recommended. Water every 4-6 days. Avoid fluctuating moisture to prevent blossom end rot and fruit cracking.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 50kg N, 60kg P2O5, 50kg K2O/ha. Top dress: 25kg N at 30 days, 25kg N + 25kg K at fruit set.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 100-130 days days
Optimal Temperature: 18°C to 30°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 55% to 75%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: ONION Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: ONION
Crop: ONION
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Shallow root system requires frequent light irrigations (every 5-7 days). Stop watering 15 days before harvest when tops begin to fall.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 40kg N, 50kg P2O5, 60kg K2O, 30kg Sulfur/ha. Top dress: 40kg N at 30 days, 40kg N at 45 days after transplanting.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 110-140 days days
Optimal Temperature: 15°C to 28°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 50% to 70%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: GARLIC Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: GARLIC
Crop: GARLIC
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Irrigate every 8-10 days during vegetative phase. Bulb development stage needs adequate moisture. Withhold water 10 days before digging.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 50kg N, 50kg P2O5, 50kg K2O, 25kg Sulfur/ha. Top dress: 50kg N at 40 days.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 125-150 days days
Optimal Temperature: 14°C to 26°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 50% to 70%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: TURMERIC Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: TURMERIC
Crop: TURMERIC
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Sprouting (15-20d), Rhizome development (60-90d), and Rhizome bulking (120-150d). Irrigate every 7-10 days.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 30kg N, 60kg P2O5, 60kg K2O/ha + 25t FYM. Top dress: 30kg N at 60 days, 30kg N + 30kg K at 90 days.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 210-270 days days
Optimal Temperature: 20°C to 34°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 70% to 90%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: CHILLI Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: CHILLI
Crop: CHILLI
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Transplanting, flowering, and fruit setting require steady moisture. Drip irrigation prevents root rot.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 40kg N, 50kg P2O5, 40kg K2O/ha. Top dress: 30kg N at 30 days, 30kg N at flowering.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 120-160 days days
Optimal Temperature: 20°C to 32°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 55% to 75%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: GINGER Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: GINGER
Crop: GINGER
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Germination (15-30d), rhizome initiation (60-70d), and rhizome bulking (100-130d). Needs heavy mulching and regular watering.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 25kg N, 50kg P2O5, 50kg K2O/ha + 25t FYM. Top dress: 25kg N at 45 days, 25kg N + 25kg K at 90 days.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 210-240 days days
Optimal Temperature: 20°C to 32°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 70% to 90%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: CARDAMOM Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: CARDAMOM
Crop: CARDAMOM
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Shade-loving hill crop. Regular sprinkler/drip irrigation during summer (Feb-May) at 10-15 day intervals.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Annual dosage: 75kg N, 75kg P2O5, 150kg K2O/ha in two splits (May-Jun and Sep-Oct).
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: Perennial (Bearing from 3rd year) days
Optimal Temperature: 15°C to 26°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 75% to 95%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: MANGO Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: MANGO
Crop: MANGO
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Young trees: weekly watering. Bearing trees: stop irrigation 2-3 months prior to flowering to induce flower buds; resume after fruit set.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Bearing tree: 1000g N, 500g P2O5, 1000g K2O per tree per year applied post-harvest (Jul-Aug).
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: Perennial (Fruit matures in 100-120 days from bloom) days
Optimal Temperature: 20°C to 38°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 50% to 75%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: BANANA Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: BANANA
Crop: BANANA
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Very high water requirement. Irrigate every 3-4 days in summer, 7-8 days in winter. Drip irrigation saves 40% water.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: 200g N, 60g P2O5, 300g K2O per plant applied in 4-5 splits up to shooting stage.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 300-365 days days
Optimal Temperature: 20°C to 35°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 70% to 90%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: GRAPES Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: GRAPES
Crop: GRAPES
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Irrigate after April pruning. Withhold water 15-20 days before harvest to build sugar (Brix).
Fertilizer & NPK Management: 500g N, 500g P2O5, 1000g K2O per vine applied in two splits after foundation and forward prunings.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 120-140 days per fruiting season days
Optimal Temperature: 15°C to 32°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 50% to 75%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: APPLE Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: APPLE
Crop: APPLE
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Fruit bud break, petal fall, and fruit development are critical. Needs winter chilling (<7°C for 800-1200 hours).
Fertilizer & NPK Management: 700g N, 350g P2O5, 700g K2O per bearing tree applied in split doses.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: Perennial (Harvest Jul-Oct) days
Optimal Temperature: 5°C to 24°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 60% to 80%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: ORANGE Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: ORANGE
Crop: ORANGE
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Irrigate at 10-15 day intervals in winter and 5-7 days in summer. Avoid water contact with tree trunk.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: 600g N, 200g P2O5, 300g K2O per tree per year split in 3 doses (Feb, May, Oct).
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: Perennial (Fruit matures in 8-9 months) days
Optimal Temperature: 15°C to 35°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 50% to 75%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: PAPAYA Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: PAPAYA
Crop: PAPAYA
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Continuous soil moisture required; water every 6-8 days in winter, 4-5 days in summer. Strictly avoid waterlogging.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: 250g N, 250g P2O5, 500g K2O per plant per year applied bimonthly.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 270-360 days to first harvest days
Optimal Temperature: 20°C to 35°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 65% to 85%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: POMEGRANATE Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: POMEGRANATE
Crop: POMEGRANATE
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Give water stress for 1-2 months for bahar treatment, then resume light irrigation followed by regular watering.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: 625g N, 250g P2O5, 250g K2O per plant per year.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 135-180 days from fruit set to harvest days
Optimal Temperature: 18°C to 38°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 45% to 70%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: COCONUT Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: COCONUT
Crop: COCONUT
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Irrigate palms with 40-50 liters/day per palm through basin or drip during dry months.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: 500g N, 320g P2O5, 1200g K2O per palm per year in two splits (May-Jun and Sep-Oct).
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: Perennial (Year-round monthly harvest) days
Optimal Temperature: 22°C to 34°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 70% to 90%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: WATERMELON Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: WATERMELON
Crop: WATERMELON
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Irrigate every 5-7 days. Reduce watering when fruits start ripening to increase sweetness and prevent splitting.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 40kg N, 60kg P2O5, 60kg K2O/ha. Top dress: 40kg N at vine elongation.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 80-100 days days
Optimal Temperature: 24°C to 35°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 50% to 75%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: MUSKMELON Cultivation Guide
text:
CROP AGRONOMY GUIDE: MUSKMELON
Crop: MUSKMELON
Irrigation & Watering Schedule: Irrigate along furrow every 6-8 days. Withhold water 5-7 days before harvest for higher TSS/sweetness.
Fertilizer & NPK Management: Basal: 50kg N, 50kg P2O5, 50kg K2O/ha. Top dress: 50kg N at flowering.
Crop Maturity & Growth Duration: 75-90 days days
Optimal Temperature: 24°C to 36°C
Optimal Relative Humidity: 50% to 70%
Soil & Nutrient Advice: Ensure balanced NPK application, soil pH between 6.0-7.5, and zinc/iron supplementation.

title: Wheat Yellow & Brown Rust (Puccinia spp.)
text:
Wheat Yellow Rust (Stripe Rust) and Brown Rust (Leaf Rust):
Symptoms: Yellow-orange or brown pustules arranged in parallel stripes on leaves, causing premature drying.
Chemical Treatment: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 1 ml/L or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1 ml/L upon first appearance of yellow pustules. Repeat after 15 days if necessary.
Organic & Cultural Control: Grow rust-resistant varieties (HD 2967, HD 3086, DBW 187, DBW 222). Avoid late sowing and excessive nitrogen fertilization.

title: Paddy Rice Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae) and Brown Spot
text:
Paddy Rice Blast and Brown Leaf Spot:
Symptoms: Spindle-shaped/diamond lesions with grey centers and brown margins on leaves and panicles; neck blast causes panicle breakage and chaffy grains.
Chemical Treatment: Spray Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g/L or Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5 ml/L at tillering and boot leaf stages. For brown spot, spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L.
Organic Control: Seed treatment with Trichoderma harzianum @ 5g/kg seed. Apply Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 2.5 kg/ha in soil with FYM.

title: Paddy Khaira Disease (Zinc Deficiency)
text:
Khaira Disease in Paddy (Rice):
Cause: Severe micronutrient Zinc (Zn) deficiency occurring commonly in waterlogged, alkaline calcareous soils.
Symptoms: Yellowing between veins in young leaves 2-3 weeks after transplanting; rusty bronze or reddish-brown spots merge and leaves wither.
Correction & Treatment: Foliar spray of Zinc Sulphate (ZnSO4 21%) @ 5 kg + 2.5 kg slaked lime in 1000 liters of water per hectare (or 5g ZnSO4 + 2.5g lime per liter). Apply basal Zinc Sulphate @ 25 kg/ha during field preparation.

title: Potato and Tomato Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans)
text:
Potato and Tomato Late Blight:
Symptoms: Water-soaked, dark brown to black irregular lesions on leaf margins with white mildew underneath during high humidity; rapid vine rot and tuber blighting.
Chemical Treatment: Preventive spray of Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 3 g/L. Upon outbreak, spray systemic Cymoxanil + Mancozeb (Curzate) @ 2.5 g/L or Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold) @ 2.5 g/L.
Organic & Cultural: Destroy infected haulms before harvest; provide good furrow drainage and avoid overhead sprinkler watering.

title: Cotton Pink Bollworm and Sucking Pests (Whitefly, Aphids)
text:
Cotton Pink Bollworm (Pectinophora gossypiella) and Sucking Pests (Whitefly, Thrips, Jassids):
Symptoms: Rosetted flowers, drilled squares and bolls, damaged lint and premature boll dropping. Sucking pests cause leaf curling and honeydew mold.
Pink Bollworm Management: Install Pheromone Traps (Gossyplure) @ 8-10 traps/acre. Spray Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.5 g/L or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC (Coragen) @ 0.3 ml/L.
Sucking Pests & Whiteflies: Install Yellow Sticky Traps @ 15-20/acre. Spray Neem Oil 1500 ppm @ 5 ml/L or Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.2 g/L or Flonicamid 50% WG @ 0.3 g/L.

title: Mustard Aphid (Lipaphis erysimi) and White Rust
text:
Mustard / Rapeseed Aphids and White Rust (Albugo candida):
Symptoms: Tiny greenish aphids suck sap from inflorescence, pods, and tender shoots, stunting pod formation. White rust causes chalky blisters on leaf undersides and stag-head floral malformation.
Aphid Management: Early sowing before October 15 escapes aphid attack. Spray Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.5 ml/L or Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.25 g/L when aphid colony exceeds 25 insects per 10 cm terminal branch.
White Rust Treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2 g/L or Ridomil Gold @ 2 g/L.

title: Maize Fall Armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda)
text:
Maize Fall Armyworm (FAW):
Symptoms: Pin holes, ragged shot-hole feeding on leaves, heavy sawdust-like frass inside leaf whorl, destroyed central growing shoot.
Management: Handpicking egg masses in small plots; application of neem cake in soil. Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.4 ml/L or Spinetoram 11.7% SC @ 0.5 ml/L directed into leaf whorls. Apply biological Metarhizium anisopliae or Beauveria bassiana @ 5 g/L.

title: Chilli and Vegetable Leaf Curl Virus (Gemini Virus)
text:
Chilli Leaf Curl Virus and Tomato Leaf Curl:
Vector: Transmitted by Whiteflies (Bemisia tabaci) and Thrips.
Symptoms: Upward curling and crinkling of leaves, reduced leaf size, stunted bushy plants with no fruit setting.
Treatment: Viruses cannot be cured by fungicides; control the insect vector promptly! Install yellow and blue sticky traps (15/acre). Spray Fipronil 5% SC @ 2 ml/L or Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.5 ml/L or Neem Oil @ 5 ml/L. Uproot and burn severely infected plants.

title: Gram / Chickpea Fusarium Wilt and Pod Borer
text:
Gram (Chickpea) Fusarium Wilt and Helicoverpa Pod Borer:
Wilt Symptoms: Sudden drooping of leaves, vascular browning inside stem root xylem.
Wilt Management: Deep summer ploughing; seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 5g/kg seed or Carbendazim @ 2g/kg. Crop rotation with wheat or mustard.
Pod Borer: Install Pheromone Traps (Helilure) @ 5/acre. Spray NPV (Nuclear Polyhedrosis Virus) @ 250 LE/ha or Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.5 g/L during pod formation.

title: Balanced NPK Fertilizer Management and Dosage
text:
Balanced NPK Fertilizer Application:
General Ideal Ratio: 4:2:1 (N:P2O5:K2O) for cereal crops (Wheat, Paddy, Maize); 1:2:1 for pulse legumes (Gram, Moong, Arhar) since legumes fix atmospheric nitrogen.
Nitrogen (Urea 46% N): Apply 50% basal at sowing, 25% at active tillering, and 25% at panicle/flowering initiation. Avoid excess urea which causes lodging and disease vulnerability.
Phosphorus (DAP 18:46:0 or SSP 16% P2O5): 100% applied as basal dose placed near root zone during final ploughing for root elongation.
Potassium (Muriate of Potash MOP 60% K2O): Crucial for grain weight, starch formation, drought resistance, and pest protection.

title: Organic Manures, Vermicompost, and FYM
text:
Farm Yard Manure (FYM) and Vermicompost:
FYM Dosage: Apply 8-10 tons/hectare of well-decomposed FYM 3-4 weeks before sowing and incorporate thoroughly.
Vermicompost: Rich organic manure produced by earthworms (Eisenia fetida). Dose: 2.5-3 tons/ha for field crops; 5 kg per fruit tree. Increases soil water retention by 25% and improves beneficial microbial count.
Green Manuring: Sowing Sunnhemp (Crotalaria juncea) or Dhaincha (Sesbania aculeata) and ploughing into the soil at 45 days adds 60-80 kg organic nitrogen per hectare.

title: Jeevamrit & Natural Farming Organic Formulations
text:
Jeevamrit Organic Biostimulant Preparation (Subhash Palekar Natural Farming):
Ingredients (for 1 acre): 200 Liters water, 10 kg fresh desi cow dung, 5-10 Liters desi cow urine, 2 kg jaggery (gur), 2 kg pulse flour (besan), handful of virgin fertile field soil.
Preparation: Mix in a drum kept in shade. Stir clockwise twice daily. Ferment for 4-7 days.
Application: Filter through cloth and apply through irrigation water or spray as 10% foliar biostimulant. Multiplies native soil beneficial microbes.

title: Soil Health Card Scheme & Soil Testing Guide
text:
Soil Health Card (SHC) & Soil Testing Procedure:
Soil Sampling: Collect V-shaped soil samples up to 15 cm depth from 8-10 spots across the field in zigzag pattern. Mix, dry in shade, and test via District Soil Testing Laboratory or Krishi Vigyan Kendra.
12 Parameters Tested: Macro nutrients (N, P, K), Secondary nutrients (Sulphur), Micronutrients (Zinc, Iron, Copper, Manganese, Boron), and Physical parameters (pH, Electrical Conductivity EC, Organic Carbon OC).
Benefits: Saves 20-30% on unnecessary fertilizer costs and prevents soil degradation.

title: Drip and Micro-Sprinkler Irrigation Techniques
text:
Precision Irrigation Systems:
Drip Irrigation: Delivers water directly to crop root zone with 90-95% efficiency, reducing water consumption by 40-60% compared to flood irrigation. Best suited for sugarcane, cotton, fruit orchards, and vegetables. Reduces weed emergence.
Sprinkler Irrigation: Suitable for undulating terrains and sandy soils; ideal for wheat, mustard, pulses, and groundnut with 75-80% efficiency.
Government Subsidy: Available up to 55-70% for small & marginal farmers under Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop).

title: Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) in Paddy
text:
Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) Water Saving in Paddy Rice:
Technique: Instead of keeping continuous ponded water, allow field water to subside until water table drops 15 cm below soil surface (monitored with perforated PVC field pipe), then re-irrigate.
Benefits: Saves 25-35% irrigation water, enhances root aeration, reduces methane greenhouse gas emissions by 40%, and prevents lodging without any yield reduction.

title: Minimum Support Price (MSP) and APMC Mandi Marketing
text:
MSP (Minimum Support Price) and Grain Marketing:
Definition: Guaranteed price fixed by Government of India based on recommendations of CACP (Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices) ensuring at least 50% profit over Cost of Cultivation (A2+FL).
Key Crops under MSP: Paddy, Wheat, Cotton, Maize, Gram, Mustard, Soybean, Sugarcane (FRP), Groundnut, Tur/Arhar, Moong, Urad, Bajra, Jowar.
Post-Harvest Tips for Higher Mandi Price: Dry grains to optimum moisture (under 12-14% for cereals and oilseeds); clean and grade grains to eliminate dust and chaff; avoid selling under distress; use e-NAM (National Agriculture Market) for online inter-mandi bidding.

1.1 Name  of Scheme: Minimum  Support  Price  Scheme  
Type of  scheme : Central  Sector  Scheme  
The Minimum Support Prices were announced by the Government of India for the first time in  
1966 -67 for Wheat in  the wake of the  Green Revolution  and extended harvest, to  save the 
farmers from depleting profits. Since then, the MSP regime has been expanded to many crops.  
Minimum Support Price is the price at which government purchases crops from the farmers,  
whatever may be  the price  for the crops.  The MSP is  announced by the  Gove

• Cereals  (7) - paddy,  wheat,  barley,  jowar,  bajra,  maize  and ragi

The minimum support prices are a guarantee price for their produce from the Government. The  
major objectives are to support the farmers from distress sales and to procure food grains for  
public distribution. In  case the market price for the  commodity falls  below  the announced  
minimum price due to bumper production and glut in the market, government agencies purchase  
the entire  quantity  offered  by the farmers  at the announced

Salient features : 
 
If there  is a fall in the prices  of the crops,  after a bumper  harvest,  the government  purchases  at 
the MSP and this is the reason that the priced cannot go below MSP. So this directly helps the  
farmers.  
 
The government decided the support prices for various agricultural commodities after taking into

A major cause for the slow growth in agriculture during the last few decades in India is said to be  
lack of adequate investment in agriculture especially public investment. Hence, the National  
Development Council has ratified a major scheme to raise investment in the sector at the same  
time by considering the agro climatic conditions and other aspects prevailing at the state and

Rashtriya  Krishi  Vikas Yojana  (RKVY)  in 2007 -2008.

Preface
Agriculture is an important sector of Indian Economy as more than half of its population relies on Ag-
riculture as principle source of income.  Research and Extension systems play major role in generation 
and dissemination of Agricultural technologies aiming at enhancing the income of farmers. The extension system adopts series of extension methods such as Training, demonstration, exposure visit to transfer the technologies from lab to land. Majority of these extension efforts mainly focus on location and crop 
specific technologies, and mostl

title: Farmerbook Pg 6
text:
ority of these extension efforts mainly focus on location and crop 
specific technologies, and mostly on solution to problem basis. However, there is a need for equipping the 
farmers with Basic knowledge of Agriculture in order to create a better knowledge platform at farmer level for taking appropriate farm management decisions and to absorb modern technologies.  
In view of this, Desai Fruits and Vegetables Pvt. Ltd. (DFV), India, in cooperation with the Deutsche 
Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH on behalf of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and

ricultural Extension Management (MANAGE- An Organization of Ministry of Agriculture, Government 
of India) brought out Farmer’s Handbook on Basic Agriculture to impart technical knowledge on Basic Agriculture to farmers to provide holistic perspective of scientific Agriculture.
This handbook is a product of series of brainstorming workshops and consultative meetings with various 
stakeholders such as Researchers, Academicians,

ng workshops and consultative meetings with various

eness and understanding of

soil testing, plant nutrition requirement, organic & inorganic fertilizers, and Integrated Nutrient Manage-

ancing the awareness of and

•	Basins are flat areas of land, surrounded by low bunds.

•	Basin irrigation is commonly used for rice grown on flat lands or in terraces on hill-sides. Paddy grows best when its roots are submerged in water. Hence, basin irrigation is the best method to use for this kind of crop.
